observed_subject.scope: packet cortex bounded transient state / barge-in atomicity

observation.accept_input_precheck: accept_input() calls _require_event_capacity() once before mutating input replay/sequence/final-turn state.
observation.barge_path: For packet.barge_in=true, accept_input() then calls cancel_for_barge_in(), which mutates cancellable outputs and tool ownership and emits BARGE_IN_CANCEL_PROPAGATED, consuming an event slot.
observation.final_input_event: accept_input() then emits the ASR input event through _event(), requiring a second event slot.
observation.boundary_case: If len(_events)==MAX_EVENTS-1 on entry, the initial guard passes. cancel_for_barge_in() can consume the last slot after state mutation. The final ASR _event() then fails capacity. The caller receives VoicePacketCortexError after input/cancellation state has already changed.
observation.risk: A rejected operation can leave durable in-memory controller state different from the pre-call state, creating replay/causal ambiguity at the exact resource-boundary condition PN10 is intended to fail closed on.

minimal_discriminator.precondition: Construct a VoicePacketCortex with exactly MAX_EVENTS-1 existing events and at least one nonterminal cancellable output plus optionally an active tool owned by that output turn.
minimal_discriminator.action: Call accept_input() with a new valid final VoiceInputPacket carrying barge_in=true.
minimal_discriminator.expected_fail_closed_property: Either the whole operation is rejected before any input/output/tool state mutation, or enough event capacity is reserved atomically for all events the operation will emit.
minimal_discriminator.candidate_product_negative: If the call raises capacity exhaustion while _input_seen/_last_input_sequence/_final_turns and/or output/tool cancellation state changed, classify PRODUCT_NEGATIVE at packet-controller atomicity scope.
minimal_discriminator.control: Repeat at MAX_EVENTS-2; the same input should complete with both BARGE_IN_CANCEL_PROPAGATED and ASR event emitted, proving the failure is the one-slot atomicity boundary rather than malformed input.

repair_options_for_wp715_owner: Reserve the full event budget required by accept_input() before any mutation (2 slots on barge-in path, 1 otherwise).
Or refactor barge-in/input handling into a staged transaction that validates all capacity/invariants before committing state and events.
Add a regression that snapshots relevant controller state before the MAX_EVENTS-1 call and proves exact equality after a rejected operation.
zero_credit_fences: This packet is review/falsifier routing only; Trigger 4 retains canonical WP715 mutation/acceptance authority.
